messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected by routing-telemetry. Smart-routing policy in eu-west-1 is flipping requests into a fallback loop between model-variant groups. Error spike: 502s and tool-calling failures for affected customers. Auto-escalating to on-call.

sre-oncall: Acknowledged — paging on-call. Seeing elevated p50 latency and a bunch of 503/502 from proxy-router. Any immediate customer impact?

mae: Confirmed — multiple Dedicated tenants report tool-calls failing with "tool unsupported" errors. Looks like requests are being routed from fp16-compatible instance to a q4 quantized variant that doesn't support function/tool calling.

jordan: Logs show the policy engine is matching fallback rules by 'compatibility_score' and bouncing to the q4 family because of a perceived cost preference. But that q4 variant has context_length=2048 enforced and our requests are 8k -> kv-cache mismatch. So we get aborts.

ashley: Tagging accounts: t-proto and retail-alpha are getting degraded UX. Notified AMs. Need ETA on mitigation before we do any customer-facing message.

mae: Temp mitigation: disable smart-routing for eu-west-1 to stop the loop. Setting route policy to static pin to 'fp16-compat' group. Will push a policy change now.

samir: Running the rollback script to disable smart-routing. Command: 
```
/srv/routing/bin/policy-toggle --region eu-west-1 --smart-routing off --reason "incident 1924765432"
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started by samir at 2026-03-15T03:24:10Z. CI checks passed, applying to routing-controlplane-1.

mae: Applied. Confirming routes now. I can see green on pinned routes, traffic shifting off q4 variants. Error rate dropping but a backlog of in-flight requests still failing with tool-call errors.

jordan: We should also block policy-generated fallbacks to any variant where capability.tool_calling != true or context_length < 8192. There's a bug in the compatibility-matrix lookups: entries for some q4 variants are missing the tool_calling flag. That allowed the policy to treat them as compatible.

devex-bot: Note: compatibility-matrix service returned partial data from cache miss at 03:18:42Z. Missing flags for redwood/rlhf-2-q4_0 and redwood/rlhf-2-q4_1.

elaine: Can we hotfix the matrix? I can patch the DB entries. Need a quick validation plan — confirm flags, run a dry-run routing-sim.

samir: I'll stop the routing loop now and then we can patch. Current mitigation status: smart-routing OFF in eu-west-1, pinned routes to fp16 group, failing requests are being retried once by edge with increased latency but not blowing up.

ashley: Customer impact summary for AMs: affected Dedicated tenants experienced tool-call failures and elevated latencies from ~03:12–03:24 UTC. We estimate ~12k requests impacted, no data exfil detected. Will draft note after SRE confirms stabilization.

jordan: Next steps: 1) Patch compatibility-matrix DB to set tool_calling=true only where verified. 2) Add a preflight guard in policy-engine to reject fallbacks that reduce context_length below request length. 3) Add monitoring alert on 'compatibility-mismatch-fallback' events to catch loops.

mae: I'm running the DB patch now: SQL snippet: 
```sql
UPDATE model_compatibility SET tool_calling = TRUE, verified_at = NOW() WHERE model_name LIKE 'redwood/rlhf-2-fp16%';
UPDATE model_compatibility SET tool_calling = FALSE WHERE model_name LIKE 'redwood/rlhf-2-q4_%';
```

deploy-bot: DB patch applied to compatibility-db-primary at 2026-03-15T03:33:21Z.

devex-bot: Dry-run of policy-engine against sample traffic shows no more fallbacks to q4 variants for tool-calling routes. Simulation link: https://internal.redwood/run/1924765432/sim (auth required).

jordan: I've pushed a quick guard in the policy-engine to validate context length compatibility. Patch ID: rwr-policy-guard-34. Rolling to control plane with canary 5% then 50% then 100%.

deploy-bot: rwr-policy-guard-34 rollout started. Canary 5% applied at 03:41:02Z.

mae: Metrics look stable. Error rate down to baseline. Tool-calls succeed on fresh requests. Backfilled failures will be retried by edge; we're seeing successful retries.

ashley: I'll send a brief to affected AMs now: short timeline, steps taken, and apology. No SLA breach expected but monitoring for 2 more hours.

samir: Follow-up actions (assigned): jordan -> add automated compatibility flag checks in model-onboarding pipeline, mae -> add an emergency runbook for disabling smart-routing per-region, samir -> write a post-incident note with timeline.

elaine: Filing the incident for postmortem. Initial severity: Sev2 (customer impact, mitigated). Collecting logs and traces.

ops-bot: Incident acknowledged as RESOLVED by mae at 2026-03-15T03:46:50Z (smart-routing disabled, compatibility-matrix patched, policy guard rolled). Please move to postmortem when ready. :white_check_mark:
